# Homelessness

## Homelessness in MA in 2024

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total number of infants and children 0-5 that are homeless in MA"

ma_homeless_total_2024 <- ed_totals_under_5 |>
  filter(STATENAME == "MASSACHUSETTS" & YEAR_END == 2024) |>
  select(HOMELESS_UNDER_5_GRADE_1) |>
  pull()

list(
  icon = "hash",
  color = "info",
  value = ma_homeless_total_2024
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Proportion of the infants and children 0-5 that are homeless in MA"

ma_homeless_percent_2024 <- ed_totals_under_5 |>
  filter(STATENAME == "MASSACHUSETTS" & YEAR_END == 2024) |>
  select(PERCENT_UNDER_5_HOMELESS) |>
  pull()

list(
  icon = "percent",
  color = "info",
  value = round(ma_homeless_percent_2024, 2)
)
```

## Temporal Visualizations

```{r}
#| fill: false

options(scipen = 999)
ed_totals_under_5 |>
  mutate(is_ma = case_when(ST == "MA" ~ "MA",
                           ST != "MA" ~ "Other States")) |>
  group_by(YEAR_END, is_ma) |>
  filter(!is.na(is_ma)) |>
  summarize(homeless_children = sum(HOMELESS_UNDER_5_GRADE_1, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_population = sum(POPULATION_UNDER_5, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(YEAR_END) |>
  mutate(is_ma = case_when(is_ma == "MA" ~ "MA",
                           is_ma != "MA" ~ "USA"),
         homeless_children = case_when(is_ma == "MA" ~ homeless_children,
                           is_ma == "USA" ~ sum(homeless_children, na.rm = TRUE)),
         total_population = case_when(is_ma == "MA" ~ total_population,
                           is_ma == "USA" ~ sum(total_population)),
         ,
      percent_homeless = homeless_children / total_population * 100) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = YEAR_END, y = percent_homeless, col = is_ma, group = is_ma)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_continuous() +
  scale_y_continuous() +
  scale_color_manual(values = hs_palette) +
  labs(x = "Year", 
       y = "% Homeless Children",
       col = "",
       title = paste("Homeless Population via Grade 1 Proxy, ",
                     min(ed_totals_under_5$YEAR_END), 
                     "-" , 
                     max(ed_totals_under_5$YEAR_END))) +
  theme_minimal()  +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(percent_homeless, 2)), 
            vjust = -0.25)

```

```{r}
#| fill: false

combined_pir |>
  mutate(is_ma = case_when(State == "MA" ~ "MA",
                           State != "MA" ~ "Other States")) |>

  filter(!is.na(is_ma)) |>
  summarize(homeless_children = sum(C.48, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_child_enroll = sum(A.10.g, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(pir_year) |>
  mutate(is_ma = case_when(is_ma == "MA" ~ "MA",
                           is_ma != "MA" ~ "USA"),
         homeless_children = case_when(is_ma == "MA" ~ homeless_children,
                           is_ma == "USA" ~ sum(homeless_children, na.rm = TRUE)),
         total_child_enroll = case_when(is_ma == "MA" ~ total_child_enroll,
                           is_ma == "USA" ~ sum(total_child_enroll)),
         ,
      percent_homeless = homeless_children / total_child_enroll * 100) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = pir_year, y = percent_homeless, col = is_ma, group = is_ma)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_continuous() +
  scale_y_continuous() +
  scale_color_manual(values = hs_palette) +
  labs(x = "Year", 
       y = "% Enrolled Homeless Children",
       col = "",
       title = paste("Head Start Homeless Enrollments, ",
                     min(combined_pir$pir_year), 
                     "-" , 
                     max(combined_pir$pir_year))) +
  theme_minimal()  +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(percent_homeless, 2)), 
            vjust = -0.25)

```

## Rankings

```{r}
#| fill: false
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "How Massachusetts ranks compared to other states in terms of percent of children enrolled in Head Start that are homeless "

percent_homeless_table <-
  combined_pir |>
  group_by(pir_year, State) |>
  summarize(total_child_enroll = sum(A.10.g, na.rm = TRUE), 
      total_homeless_enroll = sum(C.48, na.rm = TRUE),
      num_homeless_na = sum(is.na(C.48)),
      percent_homeless = round(total_homeless_enroll / total_child_enroll * 100, 2)) |>
  arrange(desc(percent_homeless)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(pir_year) |>
  mutate(state_rank = rank(-percent_homeless, ties.method = "min")) |>
  ungroup()

ma_state_rank <- percent_homeless_table |>
  filter(State == "MA" & pir_year == 2024) |>
  select(state_rank) |>
  pull()

list(
  icon = "award",
  color = "info",
  value = ma_state_rank
)
```

```{r}
#| fill: false
#| title: "Top 5 States + MA in terms of percent of children enrolled in Head Start that are homeless"
percent_homeless_table |>
  filter(pir_year == 2024 & (State == "MA" | state_rank <= 5)) |>
  select(State, 
         `% Homeless Enrolled` =  percent_homeless) |>
  kable()
```

```{r}
#| fill: false

us_states <- states(cb = TRUE, 
                    resolution = "20m", 
                    progress_bar = FALSE) |>
  left_join(percent_homeless_table |>
              filter(pir_year == 2024), by = c("STUSPS" = "State")) |>
  st_transform(4326)

labels <- paste("<strong>", 
                us_states$NAME,
                "</strong><br>Rank:", 
                us_states$state_rank,
                "<br>% Homeless Enrolled:",
                us_states$percent_homeless) |>
  lapply(htmltools::HTML)

pal_bin_state_rank <- colorBin(palette="BuGn", 
                    domain = us_states$percent_homeless,
                    bins = 5)

homeless_hs_map <- leaflet(width = "100%") %>%
  setView(lat = 30, lng = -95, zoom = 3) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.NatGeoWorldMap) |> 
  addPolygons(data = us_states, 
              weight = 1,
              color = "black",
              fillColor = ~pal_bin_state_rank(percent_homeless),
              fillOpacity = 0.8, 
              label = labels) |>
  addLegend(data = us_states,
            title = "% Homeless Enrolled HS", 
            pal = pal_bin_state_rank, 
            values = ~percent_homeless)

homeless_hs_map
```

```{r}
#| fill: false

ed_totals_under_5 |>
  mutate(HOMELESS_3_5_655 = as.numeric(HOMELESS_3_5_655),
         HOMELESS_0_5_818 = as.numeric(HOMELESS_0_5_818)) |>
  select(STATENAME, 
         YEAR_END, 
         HOMELESS_UNDER_5_GRADE_1,
         HOMELESS_3_5_655, 
         HOMELESS_0_5_818, 
         TOTAL_HS_HOMELESS_ENROLL) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(HOMELESS_UNDER_5_GRADE_1, 
               HOMELESS_3_5_655, 
               HOMELESS_0_5_818, 
               TOTAL_HS_HOMELESS_ENROLL),
               names_to = "HOMELESS_MEASURE",
               values_to = "HOMELESS_COUNT") |>
  mutate(HOMELESS_MEASURE = case_when(HOMELESS_MEASURE == "HOMELESS_UNDER_5_GRADE_1" ~
                                        "Grade 1 Proxy Method",
                                      HOMELESS_MEASURE == "HOMELESS_3_5_655" ~
                                        "Chidren 3-5 Enrolled in Public Schools (File 655)",
                                      HOMELESS_MEASURE == "HOMELESS_0_5_818" ~
                                        "Children 0-5 Served by McKinney-Vento subgrant funds (File 818)",
                                      HOMELESS_MEASURE == "TOTAL_HS_HOMELESS_ENROLL" ~
                                        "Homeless Children Enrolled in Head Start")) |>
  filter(STATENAME == "MASSACHUSETTS") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = YEAR_END, 
             y = HOMELESS_COUNT, 
             col = HOMELESS_MEASURE, 
             group = HOMELESS_MEASURE)) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(values = hs_palette) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 5))  +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = HOMELESS_COUNT), 
            vjust = -0.5,
            size = 3) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Homeless Count", col = "Metric Used to Measure Homelessness")
  
```


## By Shelter Type

Shelter type is not reported disaggregated by grade. We took the percentage of K-12 students in each shelter type, each year for each state and multiplied that percentage by the number of homeless children under 5 identified via the Grade 1 proxy method.

```{r}
#| fill: false
ed_totals_under_5_char |>
  filter(STATENAME == "MASSACHUSETTS") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = YEAR_END, y = TOTAL_CHAR_UNDER_5, fill = Characteristics)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = hs_palette) +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(TOTAL_CHAR_UNDER_5, 0)),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
            size = 2,
            vjust = -0.25  ) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Homeless Count")
```


```{r}
#| fill: false
ed_totals_under_5_char |>
  filter(STATENAME == "MASSACHUSETTS") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = YEAR_END, y = TOTAL_CHAR_UNDER_5, fill = Characteristics)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = hs_palette) +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste(as.character(round(PERCENT_CHAR_ST_YR, 4) * 100) , "%")),
            position = position_fill(),
            size = 2,
            vjust = -0.25 ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Homeless Percentage")
```


# Disability

## IDEA Overview
IDEA, or the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act, is the law that ensures all children have access to education regardless of disability. This means that children served by IDEA are those who require early intervention (e.g., speech or occupational therapy), special education, or another disability-related service. 

## Disability in MA in 2024

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total number of infants and children 0-5 served under IDEA in MA"

ma_disabled_total_2024 <- disability_under_5 |>
  filter(ST == "MA" & YEAR_END == 2024) |>
  select(IDEA_DISABLED_0_5) |>
  pull()

list(
  icon = "hash",
  color = "info",
  value = ma_disabled_total_2024
)
```

```{r}

  filter(ST == "MA" & YEAR_END == 2024) |>
  select(STATEWIDE_PROP_DISABLED) |>
  pull()

list(
  icon = "percent",
  color = "info",
  value = round(ma_disabled_percent_2024, 2)
)
```

## Rankings


```{r}
#| content: valuebox
```

## Dual Language Learners in MA, 2024

## Rankings

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "How Massachusetts ranks compared to other states in terms of percent of children enrolled in Head Start that are dual language learners"
#| fill: false

dll_state_rank <- combined_pir |>
  group_by(pir_year, State) |>
  summarize(total_child_enroll = sum(A.10.g, na.rm = TRUE), 
            total_dll_enroll = sum(A.27, na.rm = TRUE),
            percent_dll = total_dll_enroll / total_child_enroll * 100, 2) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(pir_year) |>
  mutate(state_rank = rank(-percent_dll, ties.method = "min")) |>
  ungroup()

ma_ranking <- dll_state_rank |>
  filter(State == "MA" & pir_year == 2024) |>
  select(state_rank) |>
  pull()

list(
  icon = "award",
  color = "info",
  value = ma_ranking
)
```

```{r}
#| fill: false
#| title: "Top 5 States + MA in terms of percent of children enrolled in Head Start that are dual language learners"
dll_state_rank |>
  filter(pir_year == 2024 & (State == "MA" | state_rank <= 5)) |>
  arrange(desc(percent_dll)) |>
  select(State, 
         `% dual language learners` = percent_dll ) |>
  kable()
```

```{r}
#| fill: false

us_states <- states(cb = TRUE, 
                    resolution = "20m", 
                    progress_bar = FALSE) |>
  left_join(dll_state_rank |>
              filter(pir_year == 2024), by = c("STUSPS" = "State")) |>
  st_transform(4326)

labels <- paste("<strong>", 
                us_states$NAME,
                "</strong><br>Rank:", 
                us_states$state_rank,
                "<br>% dual language learners:",
                us_states$percent_dll) |>
  lapply(htmltools::HTML)

pal_bin_state_rank <- colorBin(palette="BuGn", 
                    domain = us_states$percent_dll,
                    bins = 4)

dll_hs_map <- leaflet(width = "100%") %>%
  setView(lat = 30, lng = -95, zoom = 3) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.NatGeoWorldMap) |> 
  addPolygons(data = us_states, 
              weight = 1,
              color = "black",
              fillColor = ~pal_bin_state_rank(percent_dll),
              fillOpacity = 0.8, 
              label = labels) |>
  addLegend(data = us_states,
            title = "% Dual Language Learners", 
            pal = pal_bin_state_rank, 
            values = ~percent_dll)

dll_hs_map
```

## Bilingual Teachers in MA in 2024

```{r}
#| content: valuebox

teacher_lang_summary <- ma_pums_recoded |>
  filter(OCCP == 2300 | OCCP == 4600) |>
  filter(LANX == 1) |>
  summarize(prop = n() / 623)

teacher_summary <- ma_pums_recoded |>
  filter(OCCP == 2300 | OCCP == 4600) |>
  summarize(prop = n() / 74617)

total_teacher_est <- total_pop_ma$estimate[[1]] * teacher_summary$prop

total_bilingual_teacher_est <- total_teacher_est * teacher_lang_summary$prop * 100

list(
  icon = "hash",
  color = "info",
  value = round(total_bilingual_teacher_est)
)
```


```{r}
#| content: valuebox

bilingual_hs <- pir_b |>
  filter(State == "MA") |>
  filter(pir_year == 2024) |>
  summarize(bilingual_teachers = sum(B.14))

list(
  icon = "hash",
  color = "info",

)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Precent of Teachers, Assistant Teachers, Home Visitors, and FCC Providers That Are Bilingual at Head Start in MA"

hs_staff_summary <- pir_b |>
  filter(State == "MA") |>
  filter(pir_year == 2024) |>
  summarize(bilingual_teachers_etc = sum(B.14, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_preschool_classroom = sum(`B.3-1`, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_preschool_asst = sum(`B.3-2`, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_infant_toddler_teacher = sum(B.6, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_home_visitor = sum(B.8, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_FCC = sum(B.9, na.rm = TRUE),
            denom = (total_preschool_classroom + total_preschool_asst + total_infant_toddler_teacher + total_home_visitor + total_FCC),
            percent_bilingual_teachers_etc = bilingual_teachers_etc / denom)


list(
  icon = "percent",
  color = "info",
  value = round(hs_staff_summary$percent_bilingual_teachers_etc, 2)
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Proportion of childcare workers and pre-k and kindergarten teachers that speak a language other than English employed at Head Start in MA"

prop_at_hs <- bilingual_hs$bilingual_teachers / total_bilingual_teacher_est

list(
  icon = "percent",

  value = round(prop_at_hs, 2)
)
```

```{r}
  summarize(bilingual_teachers_etc = sum(B.14, na.rm = TRUE),

            total_preschool_asst = sum(`B.3-2`, na.rm = TRUE),

  geom_line(color = "#E51937") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = min(pir_a$pir_year):max(pir_a$pir_year)) +

       y = "Percent of Multilingual Staff*",
```
